Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but oil prices are sliding on hopes of a Hormuz deal. This could be a headwind if it spills over.

Your holdings: SOXL is still a big loser (-54.55%) and flagged for attention. CRWD (3.06%), SMH (-12.66%), QQQI (-4.06%), QQQ (-0.55%), SPY (4.29%), and SPAL (-41.75%) are also in the red or need watching. SOXL and SPAL are leveraged and decay, making them extra risky on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on oil prices and any follow-through from the Hormuz deal news.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for any signs of broader market weakness.

SPAL: SELL/TRIM - another leveraged ETF down 41.75%. High risk on margin, consider trimming.
